[http://www.io2technology.com/dojo/178/v ... technology](http://www.io2technology.com/dojo/178/v.jsp?p=/technology)

posts.post_subject: Yet another computer controlled holographic display
posts.content_md:
> "Yet another computer controlled holographic display"

From what I saw, they don't claim that it's holographic, or even truly 3D. They clearly state that it is a 2D projection , but do say that 2D renderings can look like real 3D at a distance since theres no frame of reference.

posts.post_subject: Yet another computer controlled holographic display
posts.content_md:
Good point, Larry. I should have chosen the title of the post a little more carefully and perhaps put it in the off-topic area. 

BTW- We were talking about it some more here and it reminded us of this product, which has been mentioned here before:

[http://www.fogscreen.com/](http://www.fogscreen.com/)

Although, the fog screen uses foggers like those used in theatrical effects to create a projectable 'screen'. Both seem to use a laminar flow of some sort.

TGIF!

-Phil
